name: Name
deleteWarning: This permanently deletes this customer and their entire transaction history.
emptyCustomersBody: Add your first customer to record credit and payments.
noMatches: No customers found. Try another name or phone.
emptyHistory: No transactions yet. Record credit or a payment below.
phoneInvalid: Enter a valid phone number (7–15 digits).
amountInvalid: Enter a positive amount, with up to 2 decimal places (max Rs 9,999,999,999.99).
error: Could not complete this action. Please try again.
invalidWhatsApp: WhatsApp needs a valid international number. Pakistani 03 numbers are converted to +92.
launchError: Could not open the app. Check that WhatsApp or an SMS app is installed.
backupHelp: Save a backup file somewhere safe, such as your phone’s Files folder. To recover your khata later, choose that file using Restore. It contains names, phones and entries in readable JSON; anyone with the file can read them.
restoreWarning: This replaces ALL customers and entries, plus language and theme, with the chosen file. Save a backup of your current khata first. Replacement cannot be undone.
badBackup: This file could not be restored. Choose a Khata Manager backup file (.json), smaller than 20 MB. Your current data has not changed.
offline: Stored on this device. No login or cloud sync.
creditHelp: Adds to the amount the customer owes you.
paymentHelp: Reduces their balance. An overpayment becomes money you owe them.
loadError: Your ledger could not be opened.
loadHelp: No data has been cleared. Restart the app. If the problem continues, preserve the app data before reinstalling.
previewDescription: Review the audit fixes. Final verification is still pending.
previewFooter: A separate preview. Your Flutter app is unchanged.
foundationBody: This screen arrives in Step 2. For now, review the navigation, language and visual foundation.
demoWarning: This replaces your preview customers and transactions with sample data. Your language and theme stay the same.
resetWarning: This deletes all customers and transactions in this web preview. Your language and theme stay the same.
storageError: Your browser could not save this change. Check that local storage is enabled and try again.
previewStorageError: Saved data could not be opened and has not been cleared. Restore a valid backup file below. The unreadable data will be preserved before replacement.
notFound: This preview screen could not be found.
reminderTemplate: Assalam o Alaikum {name}, aap ka {amount} baqaya hai. Meherbani farma kar ada kar dein. Shukriya.
dateInvalid: Choose a date from 1 January 1900 through today.
reminderHelp: Your messaging app opens with this message. You send it yourself.
reviewHelp: These controls only change data in this browser preview.
safeBalanceError: This backup has balances beyond the web preview’s exact number range. No data has been replaced.
conflictError: Your ledger changed in another tab. Nothing was saved. Review the latest customer and balance, then try again. Close and reopen this confirmation if needed.
lockUnavailable: This browser cannot safely coordinate ledger saves. Open this preview in an up-to-date Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari browser. Your data has not changed.
saveNotCompleted: Not saved. Check the message below; your form is still here.
duplicateHelp: The same name and phone already have a khata. Review that account first. Only create a separate account if you intend to keep two khatas.
balanceRangeError: This amount would put the balance beyond this preview’s exact number range. No change has been saved.
